name: Grid
description: Grid lays children out in equal columns: a fixed number, or as many as fit (auto), so it reflows on small screens.
whenToUse: For card grids, galleries and dashboards.

values.meaning: Steady column width, room for more items. Default; card grids.
Items share leftover space; form fields and stat rows.
Steps of the spacing scale; they shrink in compact density.
As many as fit at minItemWidth. Default; responsive.

behavior.text: columns="auto" drops to fewer columns as space shrinks, down to one.

content: Use layout components instead of margins on children.

guidelines.do: Use gap steps from the scale.
guidelines.why: Gap keeps spacing consistent and density-aware.

guidelines.dont: Use a div where a list is meant.

guidelines.why: Fixed columns get too narrow on phones.

accessibility.role: none (a div by default); use `as` for meaningful elements like ul or section.

wcag.how: Auto columns reflow to one column.

examples.title: Card grid
examples.code:
import { Grid, ProductCard } from '@ds/react';

<Grid minItemWidth="16rem">{products.map((p) => <ProductCard key={p.id} {...p} />)}</Grid>

examples.title: Fixed columns
examples.code:
import { Grid, Stat } from '@ds/react';

<Grid columns={4} gap="lg">{stats}</Grid>

changes: New stretch prop: auto-fit columns that share leftover space.

components.name: Grid
components.description: A grid of equal columns, e.g. for cards. Reflows to fewer columns on narrow screens.

columns.description:
A number of equal columns, or `auto` (default) to fit as many columns of at least
minItemWidth as there is room for, so it reflows on small screens.

minItemWidth.description: Smallest column width for columns="auto", e.g. "16rem". Default the grid token.

stretch.description:
With columns="auto": `false` (default) keeps every column at a steady width, leaving
room for more (good for card grids); `true` stretches items to use the leftover space
(good for form fields and stat rows).

gap.description: Space between cells (follows density). Default md.

--grid-gap-2xs.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--grid-gap-sm.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--grid-gap-lg.description: Gap between groups inside a section.
